WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM manager_award AS ma
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
    GROUP BY p.throws
),
hand_shares AS (
    SELECT throws, award_count,
           1.0 * award_count / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM hand_counts
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT award_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM hand_shares
)
SELECT SUM(award_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(average_share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share;
